title: iNaturalist Species ID Agreement Rate
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=inat:observation
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(community_agrees="true")) as successful by _time taxon_group
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for iNaturalist identifications by taxon group.
value: Community agreement rate is a grounded way to see which observation types need cleaner photos or more review.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for iNaturalist identifications events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for iNaturalist identifications by taxon group.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how often iNaturalist identifications works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
